question.text: In a BULLET FI strategy, portfolio duration is concentrated at ONE maturity point. Compared to a BARBELL with equal duration, which has HIGHER convexity?

explanation.text: The Logic: For the same duration, a Barbell has HIGHER convexity than a Bullet — the dispersion of maturities creates more curvature benefit. Bullets have lower convexity. The Trap: Same duration, same convexity? False — dispersion of cash flows matters. Cross-Exam Context: IV Ch 4 convexity math; XXI-B tests portfolio implications. Manager's Pro-Tip: Barbell outperforms in parallel + non-parallel curve moves due to higher convexity — a free lunch if yield curve is stable.
